title: ÆTHER: Steppu Veyyi Raa v2 (modern mass-pop hooks and production)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_styles: high-energy modern Telugu film mass dance song, wedding baraat night in Hyderabad, fun, cheeky and swaggering, a big singalong
D minor with a heroic lift, raga-shaped melody with fast gamakam slides and bends
one steady 132 BPM groove from start to end, the swinging mass bounce that flips into a triplet feel at section ends
modern mass-hero production: punchy kick, heavy 808 bass, crisp trap hi-hats with rolls, loud dry dappu frame drums underneath
a catchy 4-note synth lead hook that repeats and comes back bigger each time, brass stabs and a distorted electric guitar riff doubling it
playful gang-vocal chants and quirky vocal chops as hooks between the lines
a quirky, nasal, high-energy young male voice singing in Telugu with clear diction, playful English ad-libs
a big crowd chorus shouting the one-word answers
loud, bright, wide modern mix with huge low end
starts with a low pulsing synth ostinato and the dappu alone, a short riser, one beat of silence, then a massive drop with the 4-note synth hook and full beat by 4 s
he shouts the line like an announcement

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 18:34 on v1: 'Cool. Give some anirudh hooks and style'. v2 = same story and lyrics, modern mass-pop production traits only (music.md s13, no names in prompts): low ostinato, riser, one silent beat, huge drop, 808 + trap hats, repeating 4-note synth hook doubled by brass and distorted guitar, gang chants and vocal chops, quirky nasal male voice, minor key with heroic lift. Original melody, nothing copied.

story: A shy software guy at a Hyderabad wedding baraat gets dragged onto the floor by his uncle. His legs shake, then the dappu drums hit and he turns into a mass hero. Twist: the grandmother tightens her saree and out-dances everyone.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
